name: β-Carboline Exceptional Point Platform
description: EP-inducing β-carboline — Ph=𐑻 (exceptional point) via tautomeric bifurcation
rationale: Ph=𐑻 (exceptional point) requires a molecule with a degeneracy that can be split by a perturbation. The β-carboline imine/indole tautomerism creates this. T=𐑶 (box product / irreducible) realized by the fused tricyclic aromatic system. The co-administered compound provides the ⊙ perturbation that triggers the EP.
